guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster (Two-Tone Sunburst signature) / PRS Silver Sky
guitar.notes: Confirmed — John Mayer has had a long-documented signature relationship with Fender Stratocasters and more recently PRS Silver Sky.

tone.target: bright pop-rock clean with light edge-of-breakup and slapback
tone.profile: bright pop-rock clean with light edge-of-breakup and slapback
tone.summary: A tight, bright signal chain using light compression, a Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe), and short slapback/room reverb to achieve pop-rock clarity.

rig.name: John Mayer - No Such Thing - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight transients.
Provide light compression and even out the dynamics for a consistent pop-rock rhythm bite.
Introduce a subtle edge-of-breakup without sounding thick or bluesy.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used for its clean, transparent breakup character, mimicking a Fender amp's natural grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean sound of a Fender-style combo or Twin.
Provide a bright and articulate tone suitable for pop-rock rhythm playing.
Enhance the bright single-coil snap and cut out excessive low end.
Bypass the wah pedal to maintain maximum clarity and focus on rhythm.
blocks.gap: The target tone does not require a specific wah effect.

blocks.purpose: Provide a short, subtle echo to enhance rhythmic articulation without sounding washy.
Add a small amount of natural ambience (small room) without excessive wash.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more open, bright sound that better captures the 'small combo' feel.

proposals.reason: Enhance clarity and brightness for pop-rock rhythm bite.
